title: Chemical ordering enhancing mechanical properties of Nb25Ti35V5Zr35Alx refractory high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by arc-melting of high-purity pure metals (over 99.9 wt%) under an Argon atmosphere. Each ingot was remelted at least six times to ensure uniform compositional homogeneity.
